title: A constant slice presentation in internal module coordinates
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring object in universe u+1 [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data], X,Y schemes in universe u, f:Y→X, and k a commutative ring in universe u+1. Fix a ring-sheaf isomorphism c:underline k≅smallRing(X,Λ_X), with the sectionwise and coefficient-sized site conventions of [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data] and [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. Let N be an internal Λ_X-module, U an object of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site of Y, m,n natural numbers and q:k^m→k^n a k-linear map. Suppose the fixed-scalar inverse image of smallModules(N) restricted along c, on the slice at U, is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of coker(q) [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there is an internal morphism a:Λ_{U.left}^m→Λ_{U.left}^n whose cokernel is isomorphic to (U.hom≫f)^*N [def-sfb-point-model-restriction-module]. Finite free modules mean finite biproducts of the regular module. No assertion is made that the entries of a come from the condensed point; no discrete, Noetherian or nonempty hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Obtain the equivalence E, its pointwise inverse-image comparisons and its regular-module comparison from lem-sfb-constant-slice-module-encoding. There is no presentation or matrix in that comparison lemma.

Write F for the constant ModuleCat(k)-sheaf functor on the coefficient-sized slice. Additivity and preservation of finite biproducts give b_r:E(Λ_U^r)≅F(k^r). In Lean these are E.functor.mapBiproduct, biproduct.mapIso, the inverse F.mapBiproduct, and F applied to biproduct.isoProduct followed by ModuleCat.piIsoPi. This works also for r=0.

Let q′=F(q) and a=E.functor.preimage(b_m.hom≫q′≫b_n.inv). Full faithfulness gives E(a)≫b_n.hom=b_m.hom≫q′. Compose the comparison at N, the supplied hN, and PreservesCokernel.iso F q to obtain E((U.hom≫f)^*N)≅coker(q′). PreservesCokernel.iso E.functor a followed by cokernel.mapIso for b_m,b_n identifies E(coker a) with coker(q′). Full faithfulness reflects the resulting isomorphism to (U.hom≫f)^*N≅coker a.

theorem constant_slice_internal_presentation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k]
    (c : ConstantCompletion.constant (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) k ≅
      smallRing X (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y)
    (m n : ℕ)
    (q : ModuleCat.of k (Fin m → k) ⟶ ModuleCat.of k (Fin n → k))
    (hN : Nonempty (((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, u} f k).obj
          ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ k).obj
            ((smallModules X (condensedRingObj Λ X) ⋙
              ConstantCompletion.res c.hom).obj N))).over U ≅
      (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over U)
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)).obj (cokernel q))) :
    ∃ a : Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj Λ (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) m ⟶
        Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj Λ (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) n,
      Nonempty (pointModelRestriction Λ f N (AsSmall.down.obj U).hom ≅ cokernel a)
